title: Best cafes in Seoul: 15 spots by neighbourhood
desc: Standout cafes and dessert spots across Seoul, grouped by neighbourhood from Ikseon-dong to Gangnam and the west side.

items.title: Cheongsudang (청수당)
items.memo: Hanok outside, nature-themed inside; made-to-order soufflés.

items.title: Nakwon Station (낙원역)
items.memo: Train-station-themed hanok cafe with a cake conveyor; try the peanut cream latte.

items.title: Cheese Industry (치즈인더스트리)
items.memo: Cheesecakes made with house-made cheese; farmhouse-style space.

items.title: Cafe Onion Anguk (카페어니언 안국)
items.memo: Hanok cafe; the sugar-dusted pandoro is the signature.

items.title: Green Mile Coffee Bukchon (그린마일커피)
items.memo: Small modern cafe with a rooftop view over Bukchon; best on a clear day.

items.title: Cafe Jeonggeurida (카페 정그리다)
items.memo: Tropical-themed cafe with coconut mango drinks and views of the city wall.

items.title: Savage Garden (새비지가든)
items.memo: Vegan botanical cafe with indoor ponds and vegan yogurt bowls.

items.title: Coorownie (쿠라우니)
items.memo: British-themed bakery known for cookie-brownie bars.

items.title: Nudake Sinsa (누데이크 신사)
items.memo: Croissant-focused cafe; the onigiri-shaped croissant is the signature.

items.title: Mooni Apgujeong (무니)
items.memo: Pink dollhouse-style cafe with big milkshakes and a rooftop.

items.title: Something About Coffee (썸띵어바웃커피)
items.memo: Three-floor cafe with a large bakery; cheesecake is the signature.

items.title: Perception (퍼셉션)
items.memo: Award-winning wooden ceiling and around 15 house-brewed coffees.

items.title: Brady's Coffee (브래디스커피)
items.memo: Floral cafe in Yeonnam; pink passion ade and salt butter bread.

items.title: Manhole Coffee (맨홀커피)
items.memo: Basement cafe lined with antique British books; try the manhole cream coffee.

items.title: Cafe Pokpo (카페 폭포)
items.memo: Seats facing a large waterfall; walking trails nearby.
